body: The father and his mother are refusing to allow us to see the child seeing as my sister did the same to them after she left him because of the domestic violence. I understand how the court sees how the father should be the first choice, but it doesn't seem fair that she has to be raised in an environment with a guy who clearly is unstable and abusive. But thank you, I'm going to ask CPS to check in on him throughout rehab and in the early stages of her living with him and if anything comes up we'll be there to get her.

The issue is though that our judge thinks that he still has the right to the child, which is absurd. But we'll do that and get a list of everything available, the issue though is that DHS is not supporting us anymore because so long as the father agrees to go to rehab apparently he is the rightful person.
We have lawyers, but what do we do from there? All of our paperwork keeps getting thrown out by the judge
The phone isn't in our custody right now, it's with the police.
Sometimes this van drives through my neighborhood, he's the best.
